title: Robot Simulation-to-Reality Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Simulation setups, transfer methods, calibration, and real-world test results. The Robot Simulation-to-Reality Database closes the gap between robots that work in simulation and robots that work in the world: how the simulation was set up, which transfer methods bridged the gap (domain randomization, system identification, fine-tuning), how the sim was calibrated against reality, and the real-world test results. 'It works in sim' is the robotics version of 'it works on my machine' — each record measures and documents the transfer, not just the simulation.
capabilities: Simulation-setup records: engine, physics parameters, sensor models
Transfer-method records: domain randomization, adaptation, fine-tuning
Calibration records: sim-vs-real measurements and parameter fits
Reality-test records: real-world trials with success metrics
Gap analyses: where sim and real diverged and why

title: Robot Simulation-to-Reality Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. The gap sources: unmodeled dynamics (friction, backlash, cable stiffness), sensor differences (noise, latency, calibration), contact physics (simulators approximate), timing (control loop jitter). Transfer methods: domain randomization (train across parameter distributions so reality is 'just another domain'); system identification (fit sim parameters to real measurements); adaptation (fine-tune the policy on real data); progressive nets / residual learning (learn the sim-to-real delta). Calibration: measure real parameters (mass, friction, latency), update sim, re-validate. Protocol: train in sim -> calibrate -> test in reality (fixed protocol, N trials) -> gap analysis -> improve sim -> repeat. Metrics: sim success, real success, transfer ratio = real/sim; target ratio with confidence intervals.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

title: Robot Simulation-to-Reality Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: gap test (known gap sources listed); fitting test (parameters converge to measured values); protocol test (iterations improve the ratio or flag stall); determinism test. Limitations: demos simulate the fitting; real calibration needs hardware; some gaps (contact physics) resist modeling. Every reality-test record states trial count and conditions.

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
